english:
Casting your Super at Critical Health or while affected by an element-matching buff grants 15% increased Super Ability Damage.

One-Off Supers are only buffed for 7 seconds. Roaming Supers are buffed for their duration.

Matching buffs by element:
• <arc Arc />: <arc Amplified />, <arc Bolt Charge />
• <solar Solar />: <solar Cure />, <solar Radiant />, <solar Restoration />
• <void Void />: <void Devour />, <void Invisibility />, <void Void Overshield />
• <stasis Stasis />: <stasis Frost Armor />

<strand Strand /> only works when the Super is cast at Critical Health, because <strand Woven Mail /> is removed on Super Cast.

source.text:
On Super Cast, while at Critical Health or affected by an Element-Matching Buff:

15% Increased Super Ability Damage.
One-Off Supers are only buffed for 7 seconds.
Roaming Supers are buffed until it runs out.

Arc = ↑Amplified ↑Bolt Charge
Solar = ↑Cure ↑Radiant ↑Restoration
Void = ↑Devour ↑Invisibility ↑Void Overshield
Stasis = ↑Frost Armor

Strand can only function when cast at Critical Health.
(This is due to Woven Mail being removed on Super Cast)
